title: Oru Thalai Raagam
desc: Subhadra's mother faces criticism from society after her father abandons them. Her mother wishes Subhadra to live a scrupulous life but is shocked when she falls in love with Raja.

title: Sakthi Leelai
desc: Sage Bhringi worships only Lord Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu. When Goddess Parvati stands in his way, he goes to the extent of giving rise to a demon.

title: Kadal Pookkal
desc: Two friends, Karuthaiya and Peter, find their bond tested when a personal tragedy strikes one of their families, leading them on a quest for justice.

title: Kaveri
desc: Kaveri grows up in an ashram after losing her parents in a religious riot. However, things take a turn when two men from different villages fall in love with her at the same time.

title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.
